concerns.concern: The new combustion point is a protocol extension, not independent validation: both references use gri30.yaml and adiabatic HP equilibrium, and no matched observation is present, so conclusions remain bounded to E3.

The docking decision shares one 1PXX receptor and protocol; seed spread does not test receptor, grid, exhaustiveness, or ligand-preparation sensitivity, and docking scores are not affinity or efficacy measurements.
The solubility external set is entirely OOD for the frozen model, while target semantics and conditions are not fully comparable; it cannot support generalization or population-wide failure claims.
The battery archive lacks capacity, resistance, uncertainty, and cross-cell metadata; normalization or step traces cannot recover those observations, so degradation conclusions are not identifiable.

Materials evidence is discovery metadata rather than condition-complete records, so alloy, processing, microstructure, hydrogen environment, loading, method, property, and uncertainty effects cannot be separated.

Reproduction and bundle gates establish lineage and integrity, but replayed bundles are not 30 fresh engine executions; the reproduction count should not be treated as independent computational replication.

limitations: This review is limited to the supplied registered records; no new external source or experiment was available.
The stored readiness state still reports final_exam_pass=false, master_problem_discovery_recorded=false, and three_live_review_roles=false.
No compatible Cantera E3-to-E4 comparison or condition-complete battery/materials record is present.
The OOD solubility result does not quantify failure for future in-domain populations.
response.summary: Core evidence boundaries are mostly preserved, but conclusions remain protocol- and source-limited: combustion is E3-only, docking is single-structure E2, solubility is all-OOD, and battery/materials decisions are externally blocked.

concerns.concern: Docking support is receptor- and protocol-dependent, and docking scores are not measured affinity or efficacy; broader binding or efficacy claims exceed the E2 ceiling.

The solubility external result supports only a bounded OOD finding: all 56 records were OOD and source-condition semantics remain non-equivalent, so unrestricted generalization or a universal model-failure claim is unsupported.
Battery degradation remains a no-decision because capacity, resistance, uncertainty, and comparable condition metadata are absent; normalization cannot recover missing observations.
Materials records are discovery metadata rather than condition-complete observations, so alloy, processing, hydrogen environment, or safety comparisons are unsupported.
The new Cantera phi=1.05 result narrows an E3 computational condition map but lacks a compatible E4 comparison and cannot support experimental or mechanism-independent performance claims.
The deterministic molecule result is E2 computational evidence and supports reproducibility or descriptor output only, not biological efficacy or safety conclusions.

response.summary: Evidence quality is strongest for bounded computational reproducibility and condition-specific simulation. Claims must remain within their evidence ceilings, while OOD solubility findings and battery/materials no-decisions remain visible pending compatible independent data.

Bundle and ledger checks establish provenance, integrity, and reference consistency, but bundle replay is explicitly not equivalent to 30 fresh engine executions; the reproduction gate must not be interpreted as independent rerun evidence.

The molecule result is reproducible as a registered E2 computational artifact with run, input hash, bundle hash, and evidence ID, but descriptor/model implementation and environment details are not exposed; it supports only the narrow computational boundary, not efficacy.

Docking reproducibility remains protocol-dependent: 1PXX chain A, declared grid, and seeds are recorded, but exhaustiveness variation and an independent receptor comparison are missing; complete receptor-preparation, grid, seed, and engine manifests are needed before stronger interpretation.

External validation remains blocked or non-comparable: solubility records are entirely OOD, battery records lack capacity/resistance/uncertainty fields, and materials records lack condition-complete observations; these support refusal boundaries, not positive generalization.
